title: Valid CA Public Key File Record Layout
applicability: Applies to the CA Public Key File exchanged alongside EMV key-load processing (Element 'CA Public Key File Data'); a standalone file artifact, not a field carried inside the Segment 100 authorization payload itself.
source: docs/specs/extracted_text.txt Appendix S-1 through S-2 (record layout); Data Segment No. 132 at line ~14234 (CA Public Key File Load Segment, which only carries a checksum/version summary of this file, confirming the file's own content is external to Segment 100/130)
scopeNote: Appendix S describes a standalone ASCII file (comma-separated fields, CRLF-terminated) with one header record and repeating key records. The key-record fields match the well-known CA Public Key (CAPK) layout used industry-wide for EMV terminal key management. The Certification Authority Public Key Check Sum is the one genuinely cross-field, cryptographically verifiable rule in this appendix ("a check value calculated on the concatenation of all parts of the Certification Authority Public Key ... using SHA-1"), and is independently recomputed here, mirroring Appendix N's Luhn check digit and Appendix O's Luhn token check digit.

businessRequirements.title: A CA Public Key file header record shall use the CA_KEYS file name and a 4-digit File Version, comma-separated and CRLF-terminated.

Each CA Public Key record shall contain exactly the 8 fields Appendix S defines (Expiry Date, Hash Algorithm Indicator, Public Key Algorithm Indicator, RID, Index, Modulus, Exponent, Check Sum), comma-separated and CRLF-terminated.
Expiry Date shall be exactly 8 numeric digits forming a structurally valid MMDDYYYY calendar date.
Certification Authority Hash Algorithm Indicator shall be the fixed value '01' (SHA-1); Appendix S states no other value is currently supported.
Certification Authority Public Key Algorithm Indicator shall be the fixed value '01' (RSA); Appendix S states no other value is currently supported.

sourceAnchor.field: Certification Authority Public Key Algorithm Indicator

businessRequirements.title: Registered Application Provider Identifier (RID) shall be 1-10 alphanumeric characters.
Index shall be exactly 2 hex characters.
Modulus shall be non-empty, even-length hex (whole bytes).
Exponent shall be '03' or the long-form '065537' (2^16+1); Appendix S states no other value is defined.
Certification Authority Public Key Check Sum shall equal SHA-1(RID || Index || Modulus || Exponent) over the hex-decoded bytes of each field.

sourceAnchor.field: Certification Authority Public Key Check Sum

businessRequirements.title: An EMV Segment 100/130 transaction shall use CA key configuration consistent with the applicable EMV AID and public-key data.

testCases.positive: valid MMDDYYYY expiry, '01'/'01' algorithm indicators, 1-10 char RID, 2-hex-char index, even-length hex modulus, '03'/'065537' exponent
Check Sum matches independently recomputed SHA-1(RID||Index||Modulus||Exponent) for both '03' and '065537' exponent forms
negative: checksum computed over a different exponent value than the one declared

testCases.positive: EMV AID resolves to valid configured CA key

testDataReadinessSummary.note: All ten BRs are backed by AppendixSCaPublicKeyFileOracle and AppendixSCaPublicKeyFileOracleTest (26 unit tests). The checksum BR is independently verified by recomputing SHA-1 over hex-decoded field bytes, not merely checking format. AID-to-key resolution is out of scope and explicitly flagged as external-fixture-required.

testDataStatus: AppendixSCaPublicKeyFileOracle implements bounded, structural and cryptographic checks for nine of ten BRs: header-record format, key-record framing (exactly 8 comma-separated fields, CRLF-terminated), Expiry Date calendar validity, fixed Hash/Public-Key Algorithm Indicators, RID/Index/Modulus format bounds, Exponent value set, and independently-recomputed SHA-1 checksum verification. CA-to-EMV-AID configuration consistency remains REVIEW_REQUIRED because Appendix S states only the file/record layout, not an AID-to-key resolution formula, and genuine resolution requires a real production key file.
remaining: Obtain the real CA key-file/key-load artifact for the AID-to-key link check (BR-SEG100-APPS-CA-EMV-LINK); do not synthesize it.
Do not treat Appendix S as part of ordinary Segment 100 financial JSON validation - it is a standalone file artifact exchanged via the separate Segment 132 CA Public Key File Load request/response.

If RSA key-strength policy (e.g. minimum modulus bit length) is ever required, source it from BUYPASS/network key-management policy, not from Appendix S's own text, which states only field format/length.
